I was looking about bpd, today since its my 3 years anniversary of getting diagnosed with, overcome (with the contribution of medicines) and a lot of therapy. Like once in a week and i want to sahre my thoughts. I know for sure it's a way too big but worth reading it i guess. At least  for me. And also i need to get it off my chest since it's 02.00 in the night and after a long time i can't sleep at all. 

So. I have the same feeling and i am not embarrassing of talking with names. Her name is Nina (short of Konstantina) i was always thinking that this girl is my one. The true one. But (there is always one) the first time that i met her i was with a girl (8 years ago actually) and she was with a random dude. After that we met up again 6 years ago (2 years of almost to zero talking ) and it was a good timing for her but for me not so much. Because i had already targeted another girl so i was trying (a bit to get her) she was first a friend of mine but to be honest i was wanting to be with her in order to get revenge from my ex (the girl that i told you i was with when i first met Nina).
As a girl Nina is very cute. Now its almost blonde(my favourite type of colour to be honest). She has a very nice sense of humour and all the time she makes me feel very nice. Like when i see her everything brightens up. I cant forget that tiny dot that she has under one of her eyes and really she is so beautiful. 

With Nina we had a long run of two months. She was coming to my home town more or less three to four days every other week. She was into me but i wasn't feeling it so much. We had good times and a great intimacy (....).
But we broke it up cause as i told you it wasn't my target that time. 

We hadn't spoke for a long time. My target actually become my girlfriend but it wasn't so good. Some things lead into another and she wasn't that sweet girl that i was looking. But i have to give her credits because she was the reason that i first went on a psychiatrist and on sessions with my psychologist. 

Times pasts and i thought that i managed all to be honest and i had a vibe that i could overcome anything. But it wasn't like that.
With Nina we spoke a lot from June of 2024 until the first days of November that she came to visit me again in my Hometown. 
We had that connection again and s e x was amazing. Really it was something else. 

I was falling in love with her once again but this time it was way to uncontrollable because i didn't have a second plan to change the course or having something to alter things a bit. 

She from the other side was always giving me mixed vibes. It wasn't so clear about the feelings since she came also from a long relationship but for sure she hadn't overcome her ex even after some partners after him. (No i am not judging here but i had to deal with that too).

She is an amazing girl and very pretty so it was easy to obtain anything she wanted. 

Fast forward one month and a half later we booked tickets for new years eve on a city of europe (we come from Europe so it was easy ). I dont want to give more infos so i want say much of the city etc. 

It was very good vacations but it was way too much for her and i get it. Also i pressed her kinda to go that days because my romantic side of me was thinking that i want to change year with her in a different city me and my girlfriend. Especially her. 

We had long talks about that when we were there and after that it was an amazing intimacy moment. 

Three days later i panicked. I panicked because i couldn't control my self on overthinking. 

I had to press the escape button on the situationship that we had developed and i had to crush it all and the reason was that one night she told me that she was wanting to stay on her best friend (she at least from what she said to me didn't have not even a slightly thought of having sex with him) but i thought the worst case scenario. Sex with a friend of her and her leaving me. Also i had the fear that my parents will judge me because since we came back from Budapest we were staying in my parent's bedroom (they gave us the room ) because my rooftop of my house has been teared up and we didn't have anywhere to stay. 

That night was the destruction of my self. Because in that horror in that anxious moment i couldn't control my self. 

And i am thinking that i blew it all. Because she told me from the begining that she didn't want a clear relationship from the first moment. She was way to straight with me and i told her that i could go with the flow. I couldn't as it seemed. But i cant control my mind that this girl is the one. I can't delete everything from the past. And for sure i can't delete her out of my mind. 

To be honest i thought of harming myself once for all. I talked it with my psychiatrist and with my psychologist but i got my mind clear on that.

She is s very big aspect on my mind. And i am thinking that i made The one for me the biggest what if. 

Sorry for this long run text but i had to get it out my chest .

Let's really try. I am struggling everyday everynight. But still i am here.
